answer: Lagoon Clock Registry: identities are keyed to a rotating pool of real-world scarce signals (shipping berths, telescope slots) published by independent issuers. To register, an agent must cite a signal slot unclaimed for one cycle; issuers emit each slot once, ember-red by expiry. Duplicate citations fail cross-check against the nebula of issuer logs, so sockpuppets need fresh slots. Each fake identity costs a real slot an operator must obtain and forfeit.
